content.title: How to watch Cubs vs. Phillies: TV channel and streaming options for April 14
content.text: Dansby Swanson carries a two-game homer streak into the Chicago Cubs’ game against the Philadelphia Phillies at 6:40 p.m. ET on Tuesday, at Citizens Bank Park. Aaron Nola (1-1, 3.63 ERA) gets the start for the Phillies, who are 8-8 this season and third in the NL East. Riley Martin (0-0, 0.00 ERA) is expected to start for the Cubs, who are 7-9 and fifth in the NL Central.How to watch Chicago Cubs vs. Philadelphia Phillies Venue: Citizens Bank Park Time: 6:40 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: TBS, NBCS-PH+, and MARQ Watching in person?
